title: Mallworld with faceless people?
content: Can I just say that I'm so glad this sub exists. I've been dreaming of this place literally my entire life, without anyone to talk about it with. Not anyone who's been there. It's actually gotten to a point that I was ready to make a whole podcast to try and get it out of my system, to maybe reach a target audience. Anyway, I'll explain all of my experiences here to the best of my ability. Apologies for the long post, but I don't want to skimp on any details in case anyone else recognizes anything. Let's start with my first experience. I think this was kind of my *entrance* in a way, to be able to go to the mall. This dream happened very soon after my near death experience (which I'll talk about a bit further down; I revisited the same place later without the dying part) where I was standing on a bridge with a boy around my age. Around us was a field with tall grass and flowers. It was daytime, but dark, there was a storm that came up on us, and we were standing on the railing of the bridge. The wind pushed us over. I remember so vividly tumbling through the air, the rain hitting me, being disoriented and not able to scream. I was so scared of falling in the creek underneath us, since it was moving so fast. But something grabbed my shirt and yanked me back up to the bridge, and I had to watch as the boy I was standing with get swept away. I woke up underneath my bed, crying. That was the only experience for a while. I was probably 4 or 5? Really young either way. The next time I vividly remember going to that world is when I was ten or so. It was more like a train station, which is weird because I had never seen a train station in real life. It was almost seemed sterile though; very white and clean. I don't remember much about it, other than feeling vaguely perturbed. I'm pretty sure I just sat down on the floor and waited for it to pass. There weren't any other people though. It was so silent. Next experience was when I was fifteen. I was walking in the woods; but not the woods that I know. It was cleaner, with some paths and stuff. I was on this rather narrow path with a pretty steep drop off on one side, probably a 6-10 foot drop to the forest floor. I know something was stalking me/chasing me, but I couldn't let it know that I knew it was there. So I was trying to keep it pretty cool and not look at the undergrowth too much, or behind me, just in case it saw me looking. I was trying to find a safe place to stay when the path opened up to a large clearing with a big metal building. It looked a little like my old elementary school, but different, smaller I guess. The front doors had chains on the inside keeping them locked, so I went around to the back/side entrance. It was a really heavy metal door around there, but I slipped in and let it close behind me and I locked it. The entrance I came through opened up to a hallway, kind of like a hospital hallway but a bit more narrow. There were doors lining the hall, so I decided to try and open some. Many I tried were locked, but the ones I could open went to... wildly different places. I didn't fully go through the doors, I had this sneaking suspicion that if I went through the doors I wouldn't be able to come back through them. * An old one room school house * Very dilapidated, wooden, smelled like dirt and rotten wood, but in a good way. * A beach * I had never been to the beach, so this one was really weird to me. It was so bright. * A water park * I hadn't been to one of these either, this one felt very dream like and distorted though. It was empty, and I could tell all of the slides were off because I couldn't hear any water moving. But it was also fairly well lit, like they had either just opened or closed. The smell of chlorine was pretty strong, but not horrible. Just felt clean. (I've been back to this one, but I can't remember what the context was or what happened. I remember a really large tube slide with a glass/clear plastic window. The slide went outside of the hotel that the water park seems to be in, over a nice little summer resort type thing. It's like a little blip in my memory, like I went here for vacation with my family. It's so clear to me, but nobody else seems to remember it.) * An apartment complex * I grew up in a house, I didn't move into an apartment until I went to the city. I couldn't tell you how many apartments there were though, it just looked like I had opened up one door to see all of the other apartments in their own little neighborhood. (I actually went back to this one in a more recent dream. Some people got shot out of my view, but there was some violence. I just hid in an open apartment, I think the same one the hallway opened into. Another time I went back it was like... I knew the doors all opened up to different places, but you had to have keys to make them change to another location. I didn't have any keys though.) The last door was the most interesting. It was at the end of the hall, and when I opened it it was... well, it was a white room. But it was *my* white room. The same one I went to when I had my near death experience. To clarify, I had a near death experience when I was very young. Between the ages of 3 and 5. I won't go into explicit detail, but when I stepped into the white room the first time I had one other kid with me; the same boy that I had the bridge dream with. It was just a plain white room, slightly rounded, but I couldn't tell where the edges were exactly. Just beyond the horizon I "felt" that there was a field, but I came back before I could explore then. This time, I was alone. The room felt slightly smaller, but still rather large. There was a big white control panel... thing... in what I assume to be the center of the room. This was the first door that I remember thinking, "Well, I've been here before. I came back last time, let's see if I can do it twice. I let the door swing shut behind me, I felt the breeze from it and everything. That's when it starts getting... fuzzy, I guess. Staticky. Everything just faded and I don't remember anything for a bit and I woke up. (I had slept through all of my alarms, and it was well past 10 AM. Apparently people had tried to wake me up and I had swatted them away.) That's when I started to visit a bit more frequently. I've had a lot of dreams where I'm just walking around the mall, that's where I go the most. I can never *choose* to go to the mall either. It just happens sometimes. Sometimes there are people; they don't really look human. They're more like... fluid amorphous blobs. some use two legs to walk, others four. Most of them don't pay me any mind. If I bump into them they react differently, some of them just kind of shuffle around confused, others get a bit more agitated. Just like people honestly. I just kind of stick to myself. There are vendors, I can't always see what they're selling though. The vendors are all located on the second floor, where I tend to stay, since the lower level seems... very packed all the time. Loud. That's where the food court is and everything. The third floor is very quiet, but I know it's busy as well. There's movement, but I can only see it out of my peripheral vision. Anyway, when the vendors are open I can't always tell what they're selling. A lot of times it looks like non descript boxes, like what phones come in but in all shapes and sizes. One time I walked into a store with some other customers, and somebody bumped a box that was hanging on the wall and a human arm fell out. There was some shuffling, and the workers (I guess?) came and cleaned it up. There was some blood splatter on the ground, so someone came by with a mop and cleaned it up. It all felt very normal though. I wasn't really worried by it either, I feel like if they were going to commit any violence towards me they would have done so already. Besides, this feels like it's their domain and I just kind of show up from out of town now and then. The workers get agitated if I stay in a store for too long without buying anything, but I'm not really sure what currency they use so I just leave before they start getting weird. I've seen the boy from the bridge and my near death experiences a few times. Not just in relation to the mall world, but mostly. You've heard about a few, there was another time when I was 10 or so when he seemed to show up outside my window one night, but that was... different. I think. I've seen him in the mall recently, like in the past few weeks. I can't remember what was happening, we were somewhere in the inner workings of the mall. Something not safe was happening, and I was trying to get him to a location that was safer. I remember my work alarm going off, and saying that I had to go, and things started to get really fuzzy. Then he said, "no, you can't leave yet. It's not safe." I don't know if he meant for me or for him, but I remember fighting to stay asleep until I just couldn't. I remember my eyes snapping open, and seeing I had slept through the entirety of one alarm which is really odd for me. I've had another dream, I can't remember where on the timeline it fits though. It looks like a building you'd see on a college campus, but inside it's impossibly big. I remember a sign that said "Don't lick the walls" or something to that effect, so I know I licked the wall. It seemed to have all of time in really long manuscripts zig zagging across the whole area. There were stairs and doors and ladders that all led to various impossible places. I kind of got lost in it for a while, but found my way out. Don't remember anything else from that place though. I also know that I've been to a house, but it was empty. I think I was supposed to meet the boy there, but he was already gone I think? When I left, there were police sirens chasing me, and lights. People were coming out of the houses around the area as well, throwing rocks at my car. A big rock went through my back glass. Anyway, that's everything that I can currently remember in regards to my world. I hope I can figure out a way to go back but on purpose, because everything I've tried doesn't seem to really work. Or maybe I can find the boy that I keep seeing. I don't know. It's just nice knowing I'm not the only one.
